title: DexEngine: Scaling Human Demonstrations into Physically Executable Whole-Robot Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.33579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A growing body of recent work addresses the retargeting of human hand-object demonstrations to robotic hands. To train whole-robot policies, however, the retargeted motions must be kinematically feasible and physically executable, and be produced efficiently at scale. We present DexEngine, a simulation pipeline that turns human manipulation data into train-ready, physically executable arm-hand trajectories. DexEngine first places each clip's hand-object motion where the arms can reach it, finds an arm motion that follows the human hands, and then corrects the motion in physics simulation with residual reinforcement learning. translated_title: DexEngine：将人类演示扩展为可物理执行的全机器人数据
translated_abstract: 近年来，越来越多的研究致力于将人手-物体操作演示重定向到机械手上。然而，要训练全机器人策略，重定向后的运动必须在运动学上可行且物理上可执行，并且能够高效地大规模生成。我们提出了DexEngine，这是一个仿真流水线，可将人类操作数据转化为可直接用于训练的、物理可执行的手臂-灵巧手轨迹。DexEngine首先将每段片段的手-物体运动放置到机械臂可以够到的位置，找到跟随人类双手的机械臂运动，然后在物理仿真中利用残差强化学习对运动进行修正。基于九个人类手-物体数据集，我们为四种灵巧手各生成了约5,200个片段，并扩充为总计65,000条轨迹（116小时）和325,000个回合（578小时）。即使加装了机械臂，DexEngine对物体的跟踪精度也高于此前面向悬浮手的方法，且运行速度比基于强化学习的方法快10倍以上（原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: DexEngine提出了一套仿真流水线，将人类手-物体操作演示转化为物理可执行、可直接用于训练机械臂-灵巧手全机器人策略的轨迹数据，并通过残差强化学习修正运动，在数据规模、跟踪精度和生成速度上均显著超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: DexEngine is a simulation pipeline that converts human hand-object demonstrations into physically executable, train-ready whole-robot (arm-hand) trajectories via residual reinforcement learning, achieving larger scale, higher tracking accuracy, and over 10x faster generation than prior methods.
